snippet.title: Adventure Creator by Spinnaker (Atari 400/800) - gameplay
snippet.description:
Some gameplay of the 1984 game Adventure Creator from Spinnaker for the 8-bit Atari 400/800 series computer system.  Played on a physical US NTSC model Atari 130XE with an SDrive-Max and a Sega Genesis controller.

This is one of the earliest RPG Maker type of games that was around.  You can play in "Auto mode" to have the game create a random adventure for you to go through.  The playthrough here is an advanced adventure.  There's also a full blown editor for making your own dungeon with monsters/NPC's, though they do have extremely simplistic actions.  The editor kept locking up with the disk image I have any time I tried placing a monster, so I couldn't get that part to work.

-------------------------

0:00:00 Advanced difficulty Auto Adventure
0:11:20 Playing with the adventure editor
